add_gmock_test(mtkahypar_tests run_tests.cpp)
target_link_libraries(mtkahypar_tests MtKaHyPar-BuildSources MtKaHyPar-Test)

# suppress warnings generated by TYPED_TEST_SUITE macro from gtest
if(CMAKE_CXX_COMPILER_ID MATCHES "Clang")
  target_compile_options(mtkahypar_tests PRIVATE -Wno-gnu-zero-variadic-macro-arguments)
endif()

# The test reads its input files from the source tree, such that it can be executed from any directory.
target_compile_definitions(mtkahypar_tests PRIVATE
  "MT_KAHYPAR_TESTS_DIR=\"${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}\"")

add_subdirectory(datastructures)
add_subdirectory(interface)
add_subdirectory(io)
add_subdirectory(parallel)
add_subdirectory(partition)
